reviews.title: Excelente.
reviews.comment: Es mejor de lo que se describe, nada efecto fantasma, nada de desgarros de imagen, muy responsivo, el panel es mate lo que reduce el los reflejos. El HDR es muy bueno tiene un brillo muy alto. Tengo otro monitor Spectre (con RGB) más costoso y este me parece mejor. Los parlantes lo numormal en un monitor... Muy mehhh

reviews.title: amazing.
reviews.comment: genuinely a great monitor for its price to performance, not only is the color accuracy great but its utterly vibrant and easy to put together as well, i would most definitely keep purchasing from this brand in the future in the picture i provided you can see the color accuracy different mind you the vertical monitor is almost triple the price of this one and you see clearly see how this one scales, its obviously the best choice.
